physics_pre_check: M10 hydrodynamic buffer zone for CSF drainage

computed_regime.interpretation: Low Reynolds number (~10) means natural jet recirculation is minimal. The buffer zone must rely on GEOMETRIC EXPANSION (diffuser or multi-orifice distributor), not on turbulence-induced recirculation.

impingement_analysis.verdict: Focal WSS (~0.003 Pa) is COMPARABLE to venous pathological threshold (1.0 Pa) when jet is concentrated. Distributed WSS (~0.000 Pa) is well below pathological threshold. The buffer zone provides a 25.0x reduction in peak WSS, which is biologically meaningful for venous intimal hyperplasia prevention.

geometry_feasibility.single_orifice_diffuser_note: Single-orifice diffuser from 0.5mm to 5mm diameter requires 18.2 mm length at 7° half-angle (separation-avoidance limit). Too long for eShunt.
geometry_feasibility.multi_orifice_distributor_solution: 3-5 small orifices (each 0.2 mm diameter) arranged radially at the CSF-outflow tip. Total outflow area = 3-5x single outlet. Achieves 5x area expansion in 2 mm axial length.

credibility_assessment.key_risk: Multi-orifice distributor may be prone to occlusion by biological debris (cells, fibrin). Need to size orifices >100 μm to avoid fouling. This becomes a design constraint, not a fatal flaw.

threshold_T1_peak_WSS_Pa.note: Distributed WSS must stay below venous pathological threshold (1.0 Pa) and ideally near normal venous WSS (0.1 Pa)

threshold_T2_stagnation_zone_volume_frac.note: Buffer zone must not create stagnant regions where thrombosis could form

threshold_T3_pressure_drop_Pa.note: Buffer zone must not create excessive backpressure that would impede CSF drainage

threshold_T4_orifice_diameter_m.note: Each orifice must be >150 μm to avoid fouling/cell adhesion

threshold_T5_total_drainage_preservation.note: Drainage through distributor must preserve >=95% of single-orifice drainage

security: No API keys. Pure physics calculation.
